plugins.name: infrastructure-by-skill
plugins.description: Author Azure infrastructure as Terraform or Bicep by answering the decisions each resource actually has. Resource skills carry a grouped question set (placement, networking, identity, security, data protection, observability); pattern skills compose those resources into complete systems and own the wiring between them.
